headline: 2027 Property Tax: New Period Begins as Building Construction Costs Are Set
summary: New per-square-metre normal construction cost amounts will be used to calculate building tax values for 2027 under Real Estate Tax Law No. 1319. The new period begins with these rates.
why: Property tax values in Turkey are tied to construction cost benchmarks, which affect real estate taxation and the cost base for housing developers.
